# nah_load_balancer (Resource)

Manages a NahCloud load_balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nah_load_balancer" "app" {
  project           = nah_project.app.slug
  subnet_id         = nah_subnet.app.id
  name              = "app"
  protocol          = "http"
  port              = 80
  algorithm         = "round_robin"
  health_check_path = "/health"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `port` (Number) Listener port. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `protocol` (String) Listener protocol. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `subnet_id` (String) Opaque subnet ID.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Routing algorithm.
- `health_check_path` (String) HTTP health path beginning with `/`; must be empty for TCP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque stable resource ID.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.
- `region` (String) Region derived from the subnet and network.
- `status` (String) Load balancer status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nah_load_balancer.app my-app/LOAD_BALANCER_ID
```
